The design note says leading underscores must be preserved exactly: "_cachedValue" -> "_cached_value", "__InitHook" -> "__init_hook", but trailing underscores dropped ("trailing_" -> "trailing"). I need to know to implement the leading-underscore preservation correctly. Thanks!
